certifications: Splunk Core Certified Advanced Power User

beginner.summary: For analysts, support engineers, developers and junior administrators who are new to Splunk and need to search, report on and onboard machine data. Covers Splunk Enterprise and Splunk Cloud Platform from the user's side: Splunk Web, indexes and default fields, the SPL search pipeline, results shaping, stats, chart and timechart, eval, rex and the Field Extractor, lookups, event types, tags and macros, scheduled reports and alerts, Dashboard Studio with inputs and drilldowns, file monitor inputs, the universal forwarder, the HTTP Event Collector, and users, roles and apps, ending with a web store monitoring app capstone.
prerequisites: Reads log files comfortably and knows what timestamps, IP addresses, HTTP status codes and key=value pairs look like
Uses a Linux terminal for basic tasks: navigating directories, editing files, running curl and tailing logs
Has a laptop able to run Docker or a Linux VM with 4 GB of free RAM, or access to a Splunk Cloud Platform trial
outcomes: Write SPL searches that filter, extract, calculate and report on events with stats, chart, timechart, eval and rex
Create and share knowledge objects: field extractions, lookups, event types, tags, macros, reports and alerts
Build Dashboard Studio dashboards with base and chain searches, inputs, tokens and drilldowns
Onboard data with file monitor inputs, the universal forwarder and the HTTP Event Collector into the right index and sourcetype
